title: A metal part tearing apart
subtitle: The Sandia Fracture Challenge: where it cracks, and at what load
hook: A machined metal part is pulled until it tears. Predict where the crack starts, where it runs, and at what load.

media.alt: A glass bottle falls onto concrete: cracks run up from the edge of its base and branch, and it shatters
media.caption: The lab today: a glass bottle dropped on concrete shatters, brittle fracture by peridynamics in 3D. Metal tears differently: it flows first, and voids grow inside it.

note: In preparation: the cases, the outputs and their units are written here when the flag opens, and the measured values are sealed at the same moment (tools/flags.py seal).
